Here's a summary of the **flight change policy** relevant to your booking (**BK-B70889** — **Business** class):

---

### ✈️ Changing Flights
- **Business** class reservations **can** be modified.
- The **origin, destination, and trip type** must remain the same.
- Some flight segments can be kept, but their prices won't be updated to the current price.
- A **single gift card or credit card** (already in your user profile) is required as the payment/refund method for any price difference.

### 💺 Changing Cabin Class
- Cabin can be changed **only if no flight in the reservation has already been flown**.
- The cabin class must be the **same across all flights** in the reservation — you can't change it for just one segment.
- If the new cabin is **more expensive**, you pay the difference.
- If the new cabin is **cheaper**, you're refunded the difference.

### 🧳 Baggage & Insurance
- You **can add** checked bags but **cannot remove** them.
- Travel insurance **cannot be added** after the initial booking.

### 👥 Passengers
- You can modify passenger details, but the **number of passengers cannot be changed**.

### ❌ Cancellation (Business Class Benefit)
- **Business** class bookings **can be cancelled** at any time (even beyond 24 hours).
- Refunds go back to the original payment methods within **5–7 business days**.

---

Since you're in **Business** class, you have the most flexibility for changes and cancellations. Would you like to go ahead with updating your seat? If so, please share your **user ID** and the cabin class you'd like to switch to, and I'll walk you through the next steps.
